rules.logic: BIOC(TIM — Rogue Authenticode Code-Signing Certificate Match on Signed-Binary Execution) AND XQL(TIM IOC Match — Outbound C2 Session to Vidar Exfil IP) -> join on agent_hostname = src_host (endpoint_network_stitch pivot) within 600s. Fuses the rogue-signer execution match and the outbound Vidar C2 session into a single malvertising-loader incident anchored to the fabricated code-signing certificate, so the DC sees one incident driven by the subscribed cert IOC rather than two unrelated signals.
rules.name: TIM — Rogue-Signer Execution Match Stitched to Vidar C2 Session
